subject: website
name: Ethereum File System
summary: The Ethereum File System app, open source (MIT). It runs no third-party code, which is Level 3. It is not Level 4: when it opens it reads chain data from Alchemy, PublicNode, Tenderly and Cloudflare RPC endpoints, sends WalletConnect telemetry and loads Google Fonts.

connections.name: RPC endpoints (Alchemy, PublicNode, Tenderly, Cloudflare)
connections.note: Read without a light client. PublicNode and Tenderly sepolia endpoints are new in this build.

connections.name: Google Fonts
connections.note: Fetched when the page opens; tells Google the visit.
